## Summary
- Open (not completed) tasks whose due date is before today's **local** date now show an `Overdue` text label right after their `Due <date>` text. Tasks due today, due later, with no due date, or completed show none.
- `domain/task.ts` gains two pure functions: `localDate(now)` returns the local `YYYY-MM-DD`, built from local date parts rather than `toISOString`, and `isOverdue(task, today)`.
- `AppState` gains `today`. The controller reads the injected clock on every update, so each action (add, complete, reopen, edit and so on) refreshes the labels. `render` adds `<span class="task-overdue">Overdue</span>`.
- Nothing new is stored: the `task-tracker:v1` format, the sort order (REQ-012) and the `Due <date>` text are unchanged.

## Risks
- **Time zones:** "today" uses the device's local date parts. A task due today is not overdue at any hour. Unit tests cover 00:00:01 and 23:59:59 local.
- **No live update at midnight:** the label refreshes on the next user action or reload, as assumed in `02-requirements.md`.
- **Existing date-dependent e2e tests:** several older tests use fixed dates in 2026 that are now in the past, so their rows now also show `Overdue`. Their assertions target `.task-due`, `.task-title` and `time`, and they all still pass. The new spec fixes the clock, so it does not depend on the real date.
- The label has no styling yet. Styling and the axe/contrast audit are STORY-014 (#28).
- Fix attempts: 1. The first version added `today` only to the rendered copy of the state, which broke six existing `render`-call assertions. It was fixed by keeping `today` in the controller state, which is what the architecture specifies. No existing test was weakened.

## Follow-ups
- STORY-014 (#28): style `.task-overdue` with AA contrast and extend the axe audit (REQ-026).
- Not planned: a "Due today" label, an overdue filter or view, and a live midnight refresh (open questions in `02-requirements.md`).
